results.snippet: If you run paid acquisition for a B2B SaaS company, you have probably been handed “industry benchmarks” or PPC benchmarks scraped from a vendor survey or a blog that never says whose accounts it looked at. Those numbers are usually a black box. So we opened ours. We pulled 24 months of real Google Ads performance, from July 2024 through June 2026, from 53+ B2B SaaS accounts we actively manage, converted every currency to USD, and lined up each account’s own numbers to find the average account, so one big spender cannot drag the benchmark.
